title: JSmoky Marinated Pork Shoulder Tagine
description: A buttery, shattering dish featuring pork shoulder cooked in a tandoor clay pot with smoke and Jain-friendly spices. Perfect for an evening meal.
instructions: Mix minced garlic, fresh ginger, brown sugar, jalapenos, and jalapeno seeds in a mixing bowl. Season with salt.
Heat cooking oil in a tandoor clay pot over medium heat. Add marinated pork shoulder to the pot, turning to ensure it's coated evenly.
Cover the pot and cook on low heat for 1 hour per kg of meat, or until the internal temperature reaches at least 74°C (165°F).
Remove from heat and let cool before slicing. Serve hot with your favorite side dish.
Enjoy this one-pot slovakian dish that's perfect for an evening meal.
